name: claude-fleet
description: claude-fleet — a tmux + Claude Code setup for running many parallel sessions, one window per GitHub issue.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: The fleet slash commands, base skills, and hooks.

plugins.name: fleet-orchestrate
plugins.description: 已下架 · retired (EPIC #4333): the orchestrator is a session template now — spawn agent:orchestrator. Kept one version so an installed copy updates to this empty one; uninstall it.

plugins.name: fleet-steward
plugins.description: 已下架 · retired (EPIC #4333): the steward is a session template now — spawn agent:steward. Kept one version so an installed copy updates to this empty one; uninstall it.

plugins.name: fleet-epic
plugins.description: EPIC batches: plan, run and report (/fleet-epic-plan · /fleet-epic-run · /fleet-epic-report).

plugins.name: fleet-browser
plugins.description: Web pages a session opens show on your computer; an OAuth callback to localhost is forwarded back over your ssh (MCP authorization, /login). Off unless installed.

plugins.name: fleet-feedback
plugins.description: /fleet-feedback 一句话: tell the fleet's maintainers something from any session — preview first, logs and screen only if you say so, a feedback number back.

plugins.name: fleet-infra
plugins.description: For the machine and hub admins only: runbooks as skills — prepare and enroll a Mac, logins, a cloud Linux node, an overseas relay, hub deploy, release rules, incident runbooks, reading the doctor. Never installed by default, never handed out by the hub.
